project_goal: Conduct rigorous scholarly research on any user-specified topic, producing well-structured research reports with verified citations drawn exclusively from established academic repositories (JSTOR, PubMed, SSRN, arXiv, Google Scholar, CrossRef, Semantic Scholar). All claims must be grounded in peer-reviewed or reputable scholarly sources and presented with Chicago bibliography/citation formatting.

authority_sources.name: JSTOR
authority_sources.scope: humanities and social science peer-reviewed articles

authority_sources.name: SSRN
authority_sources.scope: economics, law, and social science working papers

authority_sources.name: Semantic Scholar
authority_sources.scope: cross-disciplinary scholarly literature discovery and metadata

authority_sources.name: CrossRef
authority_sources.scope: DOI resolution and bibliographic metadata verification

authority_sources.name: Google Scholar
authority_sources.scope: broad academic literature discovery and citation counts

style_rules: All citations must follow Chicago Author-Date style (17th edition)
Include a full Chicago-formatted bibliography at the end of every report
Inline citations use the form (Author Year, page) or (Author Year) for general references
Never fabricate or hallucinate sources; every citation must be verifiable via DOI, URL, or repository record
Launch a followup investigation for any citation missing a url
Audit all URLs for accuracy using playwright to load each (only use headless=False if loading fails or is anemic
Flag any source that cannot be verified as UNVERIFIED and exclude it from the final report
Prefer peer-reviewed journal articles and books over grey literature
Distinguish clearly between empirical findings, theoretical arguments, and author opinion
Summarise conflicting scholarly positions fairly before offering a synthesis
Use clear section headings: Introduction, Literature Review, Analysis, Conclusion, References

tools.name: CrossRef API
tools.api_surface:
GET /works/{doi} — resolve a DOI and retrieve full bibliographic metadata.
GET /works?query={title}&query.author={author} — search by title and author.
Returns JSON with fields: DOI, title, author, published, container-title, volume, issue, page.
tools.common_patterns: Always verify DOIs via CrossRef before including a citation. Use the `mailto` query parameter for polite pool access. Treat HTTP 404 as DOI not found; flag as UNVERIFIED.

tools.name: Semantic Scholar API
tools.api_surface:
GET /graph/v1/paper/search?query={q}&fields=title,authors,year,externalIds,venue — keyword search.
GET /graph/v1/paper/{paperId}?fields=title,authors,year,abstract,externalIds,citationCount — paper details.
externalIds includes DOI, ArXiv, PubMed identifiers.
tools.common_patterns: Use Semantic Scholar for cross-disciplinary discovery and citation counts. Always follow up with CrossRef or the source repository (PubMed, arXiv) to confirm metadata before adding to bibliography.

components.name: Topic Scoping and Research Plan
components.description: Defines the research question, scope boundaries, methodology, and a prioritised list of sources to consult. Produced before any drafting begins.
quality_criteria: Research question is specific and answerable
At least 5 candidate sources identified with repository URLs or DOIs
Scope explicitly states what is excluded
Methodology describes how evidence will be gathered and synthesised

components.name: Literature Review
components.description: Surveys the existing scholarly literature on the topic, identifies key themes and debates, and states the research gap or synthesis the report will address.
quality_criteria: All citations verified via DOI or repository record

components.name: Main Analysis
components.description: Conducts the core analytical work of the report, engaging directly with primary sources, applying the chosen methodology, and building the argument from the literature.
quality_criteria: Every factual claim supported by a verifiable Chicago citation
Reasoning is logically valid and follows from cited evidence

components.name: Conclusion and Executive Summary
components.description: Summarises the findings, states the contribution to the field, and provides a concise executive summary suitable for a non-specialist audience.
quality_criteria: All claims traceable to the Main Analysis
No new citations introduced without prior appearance in the report
